english.title: Drive a motor vehicle on a road with a child passenger under 3 years seated in the rear not wearing a seat belt
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, drove a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), whilst carrying in the rear of the vehicle a child under the age of 3 years who was not wearing a seat belt in conformity with The Motor Vehicles (Wearing of Seat Belts) Regulations 1993
english.legislation: Contrary to section 15(3)(a)and (4) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road TrafficOffenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 3 for meaning of "relevant vehicle".
(ii) See regulation 8 for meaning of seat belt to be worn.
(iii) This offence only applies for persons under the age of 3 years.
(iv) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(v) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied.
(vi) The Motor Vehicles (Wearing of Seat Belts) Regulations 1993 have been amended by the Motor Vehicles (Wearing of Seat Belts) (Amendment) Regulations 2006.
(vii) Children under three years of age must use the correct child seat.

The child was not wearing the appropriate seat belt.
